request: 配置 PWM 输出，频率 1kHz，占空比 50%
config:
```yaml
Pwm:
  general:
    dev_error_detect: true
  PwmChannel:
    - id: 0
      name: PWM_0
      frequency_hz: 1000
      duty_cycle_percent: 50
      polarity: HIGH
      alignment: EDGE
```
